comparison.objective: Orient and latch an SD card in a stabilized reader; not commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Thin-card pickup, pose alignment, slot insertion, and push-to-click versus tool seating, collar adjustment, and torque-bounded locking.
comparison.success_condition: Contacts-first, label-up card fully latched while reader is held versus quantified safe carriage behavior after relocking.
comparison.reason: Both use bimanual stabilization, but precision insertion/latching is not iterative damping calibration. No separate specs were present.
